page.content:
The cowboy who won the world title after breaking from The Elite.

How Hangman Adam Page connects

  • Item: AEW World Championship — Hangman Page won the world title after leaving The Elite.
  • Faction: The Elite — Hangman Page was The Elite's cowboy before breaking away.
  • Character: Kenny Omega — Hangman's world-title story turned on Kenny Omega.

What is Hangman Adam Page?

Hangman Adam Page rose from Elite tag partner to AEW World Champion by turning the cowboy loner story against Kenny Omega and the Bucks, then cycling through later factions and title hunts.

Key threads lead to AEW World Championship, The Elite and Kenny Omega.
